intro: "The Escape" is the culmination of the forbidden romance between Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield in Elwynn Forest. After gathering ingredients across the region, you deliver William Pestle's brewed Invisibility Liquor to Maybell so she can slip past her family unnoticed. It marks a fleeting, clandestine victory of young love over an entrenched rural feud.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell. It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe? What did he say??

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh...my! I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.
Thank you, friend. I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.
And for you... Please take this.
